sections.Highlights: THIS… is a 2022 Audi RS6 Avant, finished in Nardo Gray with a black interior. The odometer currently displays approximately 400 miles. The attached Carfax history report shows no accidents or mileage discrepancies in this RS6’s brief past. According to the window sticker provided in the gallery, factory equipment includes the Carbon Optic, Executive, Driver Assistance, and RS Design packages, as well as a sport exhaust, HD Matrix LED headlights, a sunroof, power-adjustable heated and ventilated front seats, a Bang & Olufsen premium sound system with 3D sound, and more as listed below. The seller reports no modifications. After an outcry from dedicated Audi enthusiasts, the manufacturer decided to bring the wagon version of its vaunted RS6 to the U.S. for the first time during the 2020 model year. It received nearly instant critical acclaim for its aggressive styling, everyday practicality, and outstanding performance. Power comes from a 4.0-liter twin-turbocharged V8 engine, rated at 591 horsepower and 590 lb-ft of torque. Output is sent to all four wheels via an 8-speed automatic transmission and Audi’s Quattro all-wheel-drive system.
